title: MiniMax H3 serverless worker input (h3-serverless/v1.1)
description: RunPod serverless input: a prepared ComfyUI API graph plus application snapshots (parameter, acceleration) and optional input assets.

prompt.description: Prepared ComfyUI API graph (node id -> {class_type, inputs}). The worker submits it unchanged.

parameter.description: Application snapshot of generation parameters (orientation, visible_frames, sound, mode, pip, ...). Used for tracing and telemetry input, never to build the graph.

acceleration.description: Application snapshot of acceleration settings (gpu_class, steps, use_turbo, lora_name, sampler, scheduler, ...). Used for tracing and telemetry input, never to build the graph.

action.description: Health check without loading a model or running a graph; prompt is not required.

assets.description: Optional input files (reference images/videos/audio, first/last frames) delivered as presigned GET URLs. The worker downloads each file into the ComfyUI input directory under name; the graph references those names in LoadImage/LoadVideo/LoadAudio.

name.description: File name (basename, no path segments); the graph references this name.

sha256.description: Expected sha256 of the file; the worker verifies it and fails the job on mismatch.

policy.description: Optional RunPod policy (executionTimeout/ttl). The worker does not read it; RunPod applies it before the handler runs.
